mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, lowering discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during a sustained FEDFUNDS decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.1% triggers a negative feedback loop where investor confidence declines, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises >0.3 percentage points in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite UNRATE crossing above 4.1% threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both demand-side indicators (GDPC1 and INDPRO) signals robust economic growth, attracting capital inflows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: No significant positive correlation between GDPC1 and INDPRO, or 60-day returns not higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion with controlled inflation (CPIAUCSL < 3%), a sustained decline in the federal funds rate accelerates growth, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL remains below 3% for 3 consecutive months with upward momentum
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly higher than baseline during the specified regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in employment (PAYEMS) reflects stronger labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly higher than baseline during the employment trend.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in employment (PAYEMS) exceeding 50,000 new jobs in a month triggers investor optimism about economic recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises >50,000 in a single month
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive despite PAYEMS crossing the 50k threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A convergence of two demand metrics (GDPC1 and HOUST) indicates robust economic activity, attracting capital and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: No significant positive correlation between GDPC1 and HOUST, or 60-day returns not higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of tight monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 2%) with stable inflation (CPIAUCSL < 3%), market anticipation of growth offsets rate hikes, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL < 3% for 3 consecutive months
regime_hint: tight monetary policy with controlled inflation
failure_condition: 5-day returns not positive despite meeting the monetary policy regime conditions.
